activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: She passed the exam, so she has to retake it.
cards.explanation: Si debe repetirlo, lo normal es decir failed, no passed.

cards.statement: I learned three useful expressions in today's lesson.
cards.explanation: Learn describe adquirir conocimientos o destrezas.

cards.statement: The teacher gave us feedback on our presentations.
cards.explanation: Feedback son comentarios sobre el trabajo.

cards.statement: A learner who has failed an exam has passed it successfully.
cards.explanation: Failed y passed son resultados opuestos.

cards.statement: A deadline is normally a person who marks an essay.
cards.explanation: Deadline es una fecha; la persona que corrige puede ser un teacher o examiner.

cards.statement: I missed a week, so I need to catch up with the class.
cards.explanation: Catch up significa recuperar el contenido perdido.

cards.statement: I study biology at college.
cards.explanation: Study se usa para dedicar tiempo a una materia.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: You can take an exam next month.
cards.explanation: Take an exam significa presentarse a un examen.

cards.statement: Please hand in your homework by Friday.
cards.explanation: Hand in significa entregar.

cards.statement: My university teacher learned me how to write a report.
cards.explanation: La estructura correcta es taught me how to write a report.

cards.statement: I revised the exam because I wanted to prepare for it.
cards.explanation: Se dice revised for the exam: se repasa para el examen, no el examen en sí.

cards.statement: You can study a subject, but you teach a subject to someone.
cards.explanation: Study es aprender o trabajar una materia; teach es enseñársela a otra persona.

cards.statement: A mark is a comment that tells you how to improve.
cards.explanation: Una mark es una nota; los comentarios orientativos son feedback.

cards.statement: She handed in her assignment before the deadline.
cards.explanation: Handed in significa entregó; before the deadline indica a tiempo.

cards.statement: A student can revise for an exam but cannot revise an exam.
cards.explanation: Revise for es la combinación adecuada en este significado.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: The deadline is the date when a task must be completed.
cards.explanation: Deadline es la fecha límite.

cards.statement: I am revising for tomorrow's test.
cards.explanation: Revise for expresa preparación para una prueba.

cards.statement: The deadline means the helpful comments from a teacher.
cards.explanation: Deadline es la fecha límite; helpful comments son feedback.

cards.statement: A course is always one short lesson lasting one hour.
cards.explanation: Course suele ser un programa más amplio, no una sola sesión.

cards.statement: If a teacher gives feedback, they are giving comments that may help you improve.
cards.explanation: Feedback orienta sobre aciertos y mejoras posibles.
